name: Junko's Part Time Job!
source:
Sometimes, things can be right before your eyes and you still won’t see them. The truth can be blurred in a myriad of ways, and usually the culprit is perspective... 

Junko’s Part Time Job is a psychological horror visual novel with point and click elements that follows a magical girl who battles anomalies to keep the world safe! However, when pressed by her friends about why she’s been acting so strange, she invites them into her world of anomalies and mystery! But as you find anomalies and search through the world, things appear to be snowballing fast into something far more sinister...

Solve point and click puzzles to find anomalies and try to keep your friends happy through your choices! It's Junko's job to keep her friends safe and she's willing to do whatever it takes to ensure their safety! Maybe, if you're lucky, you'll get close enough to one of them to tell them...

>///< !! 

Nevermind!

[From [url=https://dokidebug.itch.io/jptj]itch.io[/url]]
